description.value: Richmond Ninkazu is a Japanese sushi restaurant in Richmond, BC, operated under the Top Gun Group. It offers a full sit-down indoor dining experience with a menu that includes vegetarian options and a non-smoking environment. The restaurant is wheelchair accessible and located in a commercial plaza on Capstan Way.
